name: Wachusett Meadow Nature Camp
description_short: Mass Audubon nature day camp at Wachusett Meadow Wildlife Sanctuary in Princeton. Campers hike the trails, explore ponds, fields and forests, canoe Wildlife Pond and make crafts, in groups by age from a half day preschool camp up to week long specialty camps and a Counselor in Training program for teens.

notes: Prices are a sliding scale by family income: $42 to $210 for a 3 day half day session, $94 to $470 for a full day week, $105 to $525 for a specialty week, and a $200 fee for Counselors in Training (ages 14 to 17). Before care 8 to 9 am and after care 3:30 to 5 pm cost extra. 2027 registration is not open yet.
